hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has an entry Ndonde Hamba [njd] in the Lindi region of Tanzania.  While different from its immediate neighbours,
it is a dialect of the language in the Makonde [kde] entry
(**hh:g:Kraal:Makonde**, **hh:hlde:Crosse-Upcott:KiNgindo**:13-14, 351-358) See also: Makonde [kde].
